invariants.rationale: The method expects to operate on a list of records; assuming non-null input typically holds unless explicitly allowed.
Partitioner is used to partition records by calling its getPartition method, so it must be non-null.
Ensures that the dedupedRecords parameter is a List as expected by method signature and used as a stream source.
Verifies that the partitioner parameter is of the required type before any calls.
If the list is not empty, it's reasonable to expect that the first element is not null since records are processed immediately.
